answer: The jetty schedule is applied in sable and shale shows each instalment. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4693 identities would post 2765 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
